title: SuperTag Role manifest
description: A Role manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.RoleSpec in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

RoleSpec.description: A Role's declared policy, and the `spec` of a `Role` manifest. Apply merges its set lists entry by entry.

purpose.description: What the responsibility is for, in one sentence.

instructions.description: Instructions every Task of its Tags receives.

contextSets.description: Its Context Sets, by name, without duplicates.

permissionSets.description: Its Permission Sets, by name, without duplicates.

execution.description: The default harness, models and efforts for its Tags.

ExecutionSettings.description: The harness, models and reasoning efforts a Role or Tag allows. A Tag's settings override its Roles' field by field; when several Roles set a field, the first Role by name wins. `execution` is one field to the field manager rules.

harness.description: The one harness Tasks run on, such as `codex` or `claude-code`. Empty allows any harness the Worker Host offers.

model.description: The models allowed; the first is the default. Empty allows any, and uses the Worker Host's default.

effort.description: The efforts allowed; the first is the default. Empty starts Tasks at `low` and allows `medium` and `high`.
